command.powershell:
Set-Location $HOME
git clone --depth 20 --branch lane/watcher-cost-main https://github.com/shivinate7/claude-settings.git cost-probe-move
Set-Location "$HOME\cost-probe-move"
git fetch origin e202cfedb840f8b84df86ebec22652d42bf1ccaf
git checkout --detach e202cfedb840f8b84df86ebec22652d42bf1ccaf
git mv hooks/test_support/cost_probe.py hooks/cost_probe.py
$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false
$root = (Get-Location).Path
$files = @('hooks/test_call_judge.py', 'hooks/test_ci_wake.py', 'hooks/test_decision_watch.py', 'hooks/test_feedback_inbox.py', 'hooks/test_local_time.py', 'hooks/test_prose_judge.py', 'hooks/test_reply_judge.py', 'hooks/test_sendmessage_state.py', 'hooks/test_stall_watch.py', 'janitor/test_install_launchd.py', 'janitor/test_install_schtasks.py', 'lint/test_report_guard.py', 'docs/plans/align-watchers.md')
foreach ($f in $files) { $p = Join-Path $root $f; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p); $t = $t.Replace('os.path.join(HERE, "test_support")', 'HERE').Replace('os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "hooks", "test_support")', 'os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "hooks")').Replace('os.path.join(HOOKS, "test_support")', 'HOOKS').Replace('hooks/test_support/cost_probe.py', 'hooks/cost_probe.py'); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t, $utf8) }
$p = Join-Path $root 'hooks/cost_probe.py'
$t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace('os.path.join(HERE, "..", "..")', 'os.path.join(HERE, "..")'), $utf8)
git add -u
git commit -m "Move the shared cost helper to hooks/cost_probe.py so a test-author and a builder can each own one side of it"
git push origin HEAD:lane/watcher-cost-main
Set-Location $HOME
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$HOME\cost-probe-move"
